tool_schemas.name: drive_changes
tool_schemas.description: Lists the change feed starting at the required startPageToken and returns a page of change records plus a nextPageToken (when more results are available) and a newStartPageToken (for the next incremental sync checkpoint). Results are paged with the returned nextPageToken. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if startPageToken is missing/invalid, PERMISSION_DENIED if you are not authorized to view changes for the affected items/drives, and NOT_FOUND if the token refers to a non-existent or expired change stream.

startPageToken.description: Token to start listing changes from

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves metadata for the file or folder identified by fileId and returns its current properties (for example name, mimeType, parents, trashed, and permission-related fields). Raises NOT_FOUND if fileId does not exist or is not visible to you, and PERMISSION_DENIED if you lack access to view the item’s metadata. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if fileId is missing or malformed.

fileId.description: ID of the file to retrieve metadata for

tool_schemas.name: drive_folder_children
tool_schemas.description: Lists the immediate children of the folder identified by folderId and returns a paged result set along with nextPageToken when additional children remain. Use pageToken to continue from a prior page and pageSize to limit the number of returned items. Raises NOT_FOUND if folderId does not exist or is not visible to you, FAILED_PRECONDITION if folderId refers to a non-folder item, PERMISSION_DENIED if you cannot list the folder, and INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid pagination parameters.

folderId.description: ID of the folder to list contents of

tool_schemas.name: drive_search
tool_schemas.description: Searches Drive using the provided query string and returns matching items as a paged list with nextPageToken when more results are available. Use pageToken to fetch subsequent pages and pageSize to control page length. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if query is empty/invalid or pagination parameters are invalid, and PERMISSION_DENIED if the query would return items you are not authorized to access (those items are not returned).

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_content
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the raw content for the file identified by fileId. Raises NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or is not visible to you, FAILED_PRECONDITION if fileId refers to a folder or a file with no downloadable content, and PERMISSION_DENIED if you lack permission to read the file’s content. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if fileId is missing or malformed.

fileId.description: ID of the file to retrieve content from

tool_schemas.name: drive_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new file or folder with the given name and mimeType, optionally placing it under the provided parents, and returns the created item’s metadata including its new id. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if required fields are missing/invalid (for example empty name or invalid mimeType) or if parents contains invalid IDs. Raises NOT_FOUND if any parent does not exist, FAILED_PRECONDITION if a specified parent is not a folder, and PERMISSION_DENIED if you cannot create items in the target location.

name.description: Name of the file or folder

tool_schemas.name: drive_upload
tool_schemas.description: Uploads content (data, base64-encoded) to create a new file or to update an existing one when fileId is provided, and returns the updated file metadata (including a new version when applicable). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if data is not valid base64 or mimeType is invalid, NOT_FOUND if fileId is provided but does not exist or is not visible to you, and FAILED_PRECONDITION if fileId refers to a folder. Raises PERMISSION_DENIED if you lack permission to write to the file or create content.

fileId.description: ID of the file to update

tool_schemas.name: drive_append_text
tool_schemas.description: Appends the provided plain text to the end of the existing file identified by fileId and returns the updated file metadata (including an updated version). Raises NOT_FOUND if fileId does not exist or is not visible to you, FAILED_PRECONDITION if fileId refers to a folder or a non-text/binary file that cannot be appended as text, and PERMISSION_DENIED if you cannot modify the file. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if text is missing or fileId is malformed.

fileId.description: ID of the file to append to

text.description: Text to append to the file

tool_schemas.name: drive_delete
tool_schemas.description: Trashes the item identified by fileId by default, or permanently deletes it when permanent is true, and returns the resulting item state/metadata. Raises NOT_FOUND if fileId does not exist or is not visible to you, PERMISSION_DENIED if you lack permission to delete/trash the item, and FAILED_PRECONDITION if the requested operation is not allowed in the item’s current state (for example permanently deleting an item that cannot be removed). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if fileId is missing or malformed.

fileId.description: ID of the file to delete

tool_schemas.name: drive_share
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates sharing permissions for the item identified by fileId using the provided role and type, and returns the resulting permission state for the target. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if role/type are invalid, if emailAddress is required for the chosen type (user/group) but not provided, or if emailAddress is provided for a type that does not use it (domain/anyone). Raises NOT_FOUND if fileId does not exist or is not visible to you, PERMISSION_DENIED if you cannot modify permissions on the item, and FAILED_PRECONDITION if the item cannot be shared due to its current state or policy constraints.

fileId.description: ID of the file to share

tool_schemas.name: drive_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on the specified file and returns the created comment, adding it as the latest entry in that file’s threaded comment stream. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId or content is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or is not accessible to you, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to comment on the file.

fileId.description: Id of the file to add the comment to

tool_schemas.name: drive_copy
tool_schemas.description: Copies the specified item into the destination parent folder (optionally renaming it) and returns the newly created item’s metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed or required fields are missing, NOT_FOUND if the source item or destination folder does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to read the source or create items in the destination; raises CONFLICT if the destination parent is not a folder or the operation is not allowed for the item type.

itemId.description: ID of the file/folder/shortcut to copy

parentFolderId.description: Destination parent folder ID for the new copy

newName.description: Optional new name for the copied item

tool_schemas.name: drive_rename
tool_schemas.description: Renames the specified item and returns the updated item metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if itemId/name is missing or invalid, NOT_FOUND if the item does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to modify the item; raises CONFLICT if the item cannot be renamed in its current state (for example due to restrictions on the target item).

itemId.description: ID of the file/folder/shortcut to rename

tool_schemas.name: drive_star
tool_schemas.description: Sets or clears the starred flag on the specified item and returns the updated item metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if itemId/starred is missing or invalid, NOT_FOUND if the item does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to update the item’s metadata.

itemId.description: ID of the file/folder/shortcut to star or unstar

starred.description: Whether the item should be starred

tool_schemas.name: drive_restore
tool_schemas.description: Restores a trashed item back to its previous location (or the nearest valid parent) and returns the updated item metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if itemId is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the item does not exist or is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to restore it, and CONFLICT if the item is not currently trashed or cannot be restored due to an invalid parent/state.

itemId.description: ID of the trashed file/folder/shortcut to restore

tool_schemas.name: drive_versions_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists versions for the specified file and returns a paged result containing versions plus a nextPageToken when more results are available; pageToken selects the page and pageSize limits the number of versions returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId/pageToken/pageSize is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to view the file’s version history.

fileId.description: ID of the file to list versions for

tool_schemas.name: drive_versions_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a specific version from a file’s version history and returns an acknowledgement of the deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId or versionId is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the file or version does not exist or is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to manage versions, and CONFLICT if the version cannot be deleted due to the file’s current state or retention constraints.

fileId.description: ID of the file that owns the version

versionId.description: ID of the file version to delete

tool_schemas.implementation:
def drive_versions_delete(fileId, versionId, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0029000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0029000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "drive_versions_delete"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, code=None, message=None):
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        row = {
            "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "ts": _now(),
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        }
        if code:
            row["error_code"] = code
        if message:
            row["error_message"] = message
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_log.json", logs)

    try:
        if not isinstance(fileId, str) or not re.match(r"^gdrv_itm_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{18,}$", fileId):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid fileId.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        if not isinstance(versionId, str) or not re.match(r"^gdrv_ver_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{18,}$", versionId):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid versionId.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

        items = _load("drive_items.json")
        vers = _load("file_versions.json")

        item = next((r for r in items if r.get("id") == fileId), None)
        if not item or item.get("status") == "deleted":
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "File not found.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        if item.get("item_type") != "file":
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Only file items have versions.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

        vrow = next((r for r in vers if r.get("id") == versionId and r.get("item_id") == fileId), None)
        if not vrow:
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Version not found.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        if vrow.get("status") != "active":
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Version is not deletable in its current state.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

        active_versions = [r for r in vers if r.get("item_id") == fileId and r.get("status") == "active"]
        if item.get("status") == "active" and len(active_versions) <= 1:
            # Business rule: must not remove last active version for an active file unless converting to empty.
            # We choose to convert file to empty and delete the version.
            item["content_blob_id"] = None
            item["size_bytes"] = 0
            item["md5_checksum"] = None
            item["modified_at"] = _now()
            item["updated_at"] = item["modified_at"]

        # Mark version deleted
        vrow["status"] = "deleted"
        vrow["updated_at"] = _now()

        # If this was the current blob, advance pointer to latest remaining active version
        current_blob = item.get("content_blob_id")
        if current_blob and vrow.get("blob_id") == current_blob:
            remaining = [r for r in vers if r.get("item_id") == fileId and r.get("status") == "active"]
            remaining.sort(key=lambda r: int(r.get("version_number") or 0), reverse=True)
            if remaining:
                latest = remaining[0]
                item["content_blob_id"] = latest.get("blob_id")
                item["size_bytes"] = int(latest.get("size_bytes") or 0)
                item["mime_type"] = latest.get("mime_type") or item.get("mime_type")
                item["md5_checksum"] = latest.get("md5_checksum")
            else:
                item["content_blob_id"] = None
                item["size_bytes"] = 0
                item["md5_checksum"] = None
            item["modified_at"] = _now()
            item["updated_at"] = item["modified_at"]

        _save("file_versions.json", vers)
        _save("drive_items.json", items)

        out = {
            "fileId": fileId,
            "versionId": versionId,
            "deleted": True,
            "file": item,
        }
        _log("ok")
        return out
    except Exception as ex:
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Operation failed.", detail=str(ex))
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
        return e

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_lock
tool_schemas.description: Locks or unlocks a file to prevent changes and returns the updated file metadata reflecting the lock state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId/locked is missing or invalid, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to change lock state or the feature is not available to your account, and CONFLICT if the item is not a lockable file or the requested state transition is not allowed.

fileId.description: ID of the file to lock or unlock

locked.description: Whether the file should be locked to prevent changes

tool_schemas.name: drive_shortcut_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new shortcut item in the given parent folder pointing at the target item and returns the created shortcut’s metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the parent folder or target item does not exist or is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to create items in the parent or view the target, and CONFLICT if the parent is not a folder or shortcuts are not allowed in the destination.

parentFolderId.description: Parent folder ID where the shortcut should be created

targetItemId.description: ID of the file/folder that the shortcut points to

tool_schemas.implementation:
def drive_shortcut_create(parentFolderId, targetItemId, name, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0029000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0029000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "drive_shortcut_create"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, code=None, message=None):
        logs = _load("request_log.json")
        row = {
            "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "ts": _now(),
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        }
        if code:
            row["error_code"] = code
        if message:
            row["error_message"] = message
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_log.json", logs)

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        # time-based deterministic-ish
        n = int(time.time() * 1000)
        s = ""
        while n > 0:
            n, r = divmod(n, len(alphabet))
            s = alphabet[r] + s
        s = (s or "0").rjust(18, "0")
        return f"{prefix}_{s}"

    try:
        if not isinstance(parentFolderId, str) or not re.match(r"^gdrv_itm_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{18,}$", parentFolderId):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid parentFolderId.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        if not isinstance(targetItemId, str) or not re.match(r"^gdrv_itm_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{18,}$", targetItemId):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid targetItemId.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid name.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

        items = _load("drive_items.json")
        parents = _load("drive_item_parents.json")

        parent_folder = next((r for r in items if r.get("id") == parentFolderId), None)
        if not parent_folder or parent_folder.get("status") == "deleted":
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Parent folder not found.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        if parent_folder.get("item_type") != "folder":
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Parent must be a folder.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

        target = next((r for r in items if r.get("id") == targetItemId), None)
        if not target or target.get("status") == "deleted":
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Target item not found.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

        # same drive scope rule
        if (parent_folder.get("shared_drive_id") or None) != (target.get("shared_drive_id") or None):
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Parent folder and target item must be in the same drive scope.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

        # Create shortcut item
        ts = _now()
        new_id = _gen_id("gdrv_itm")
        # ensure unique
        existing_ids = {r.get("id") for r in items}
        while new_id in existing_ids:
            time.sleep(0.001)
            new_id = _gen_id("gdrv_itm")

        shortcut = {
            "id": new_id,
            "shared_drive_id": parent_folder.get("shared_drive_id"),
            "owner_principal": parent_folder.get("owner_principal") or target.get("owner_principal") or "unknown",
            "name": name,
            "mime_type": "application/vnd.google-apps.shortcut",
            "item_type": "shortcut",
            "shortcut_target_item_id": targetItemId,
            "description": None,
            "starred": False,
            "locked": False,
            "trashed_at": None,
            "status": "active",
            "size_bytes": 0,
            "content_blob_id": None,
            "content_text_encoding": None,
            "md5_checksum": None,
            "modified_by_principal": parent_folder.get("modified_by_principal") or parent_folder.get("owner_principal") or "unknown",
            "modified_at": ts,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
        }

        # Parent relation (enforce unique)
        if any((pr.get("item_id") == new_id and pr.get("parent_folder_id") == parentFolderId) for pr in parents):
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Shortcut already linked to this parent folder.")
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

        parent_rel_id = _gen_id("gdrv_par")
        existing_pr_ids = {r.get("id") for r in parents}
        while parent_rel_id in existing_pr_ids:
            time.sleep(0.001)
            parent_rel_id = _gen_id("gdrv_par")

        parent_rel = {
            "id": parent_rel_id,
            "item_id": new_id,
            "parent_folder_id": parentFolderId,
            "created_at": ts,
            "updated_at": ts,
            "status": "active",
        }

        items.append(shortcut)
        parents.append(parent_rel)

        _save("drive_items.json", items)
        _save("drive_item_parents.json", parents)

        _log("ok")
        return {"shortcut": shortcut}
    except Exception as ex:
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Operation failed.", detail=str(ex))
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
        return e

tool_schemas.name: drive_permissions_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists permissions for the specified file or folder and returns a paged result containing permissions plus a nextPageToken when more results are available; pageToken selects the page and pageSize limits the number of permissions returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId/pageToken/pageSize is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the item does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to view sharing/permissions for the item.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder to list permissions for

tool_schemas.name: drive_permission_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing permission on the specified file or folder by setting the permission’s role, and returns the updated permission resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId/permissionId are malformed or role is not one of reader/commenter/writer/organizer, NOT_FOUND if the file or the permission does not exist (or the permission is not attached to that file), and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have sufficient access to manage sharing on the item. Raises CONFLICT if the requested role change is not allowed for the item’s context (for example, attempting an organizer role where it is not supported) or the permission is not in a state that can be modified.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder whose permission will be updated

permissionId.description: ID of the permission to update

role.description: New role to apply to the permission

tool_schemas.name: drive_permission_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified permission from the given file or folder, removing that principal’s access, and returns a success result with no item content. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId/permissionId are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or the permission is not found on that file, and FORBIDDEN if you’re not allowed to manage permissions on the item. Raises CONFLICT if the permission cannot be removed due to sharing rules or the item’s current state.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder whose permission will be removed

permissionId.description: ID of the permission to delete

tool_schemas.name: drive_permission_add_domain
tool_schemas.description: Creates a domain-wide permission on the specified file or folder granting the given role to all users in the provided domain, and returns the newly created permission resource (with allowDiscovery applied when provided). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId is malformed, domain is missing/invalid, or role is not one of reader/commenter/writer/organizer, NOT_FOUND if the item does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to share the item. Raises CONFLICT if domain sharing is not permitted for the item or the requested role/visibility combination is disallowed.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder to share

domain.description: Domain to grant access to (e.g. example.com)

role.description: Role to grant to users in the domain

allowDiscovery.description: Whether the item is discoverable via search for the domain

tool_schemas.name: drive_permission_add_anyone
tool_schemas.description: Creates an “anyone with the link” permission on the specified file or folder with the provided role and optional allowDiscovery flag, and returns the newly created permission resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId is malformed or role is not one of reader/commenter/writer/organizer, NOT_FOUND if the item does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you’re not allowed to change sharing on the item. Raises CONFLICT if public/anyone sharing is disallowed for the item or the requested role cannot be granted to anyone.

fileId.description: ID of the file or folder to share

role.description: Role to grant to anyone with the link

allowDiscovery.description: Whether the item is publicly discoverable via search

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_list_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comment threads on the specified file and returns a page of comments plus a nextPageToken when more results are available; use pageToken to retrieve subsequent pages and pageSize to limit the number returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId is malformed or paging parameters are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to view comments on the file. Raises CONFLICT if the target is not commentable in its current state (for example, if commenting is disabled).

fileId.description: ID of the file to list comments for

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_delete_comment
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified comment thread from a file and returns a success result with no comment content. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId/commentId are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or the comment does not exist on that file, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have rights to delete the comment (for example, you can’t manage comments on the file). Raises CONFLICT if the comment cannot be deleted due to its current state or moderation rules.

fileId.description: ID of the file containing the comment

commentId.description: ID of the comment to delete

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_reply_to_comment
tool_schemas.description: Adds a reply to an existing comment thread on the specified file and returns the created reply resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if identifiers are malformed or content is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the file or parent comment does not exist (or the comment is not on that file), and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to comment/reply on the file. Raises CONFLICT if the thread is not accepting replies (for example, comments are disabled or the thread is closed).

fileId.description: ID of the file containing the comment thread

commentId.description: ID of the comment to reply to

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_list_replies
tool_schemas.description: Lists replies for a specific parent comment on a file and returns a page of reply resources plus a nextPageToken when additional replies exist; use pageToken to continue and pageSize to control batch size. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId/commentId are malformed or paging parameters are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the file or parent comment does not exist (or does not belong to the file), and FORBIDDEN if you can’t view the thread. Raises CONFLICT if replies cannot be listed due to the thread’s current state.

fileId.description: ID of the file (drive item) that the comment belongs to

commentId.description: ID of the parent comment to list replies for

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_delete_reply
tool_schemas.description: Deletes a specific reply from a comment thread on a file and returns a success result with no reply content. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fileId/commentId/replyId are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the file, parent comment, or reply does not exist (or the reply is not under the given parent on that file), and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to delete that reply. Raises CONFLICT if the reply cannot be deleted due to thread state or policy restrictions.

fileId.description: ID of the file (drive item) that the comment belongs to

commentId.description: ID of the parent comment that the reply belongs to

replyId.description: ID of the reply comment to delete

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_move
tool_schemas.description: Updates a file’s parent folders by adding any folders in addParents and removing any folders in removeParents, and returns the updated file metadata reflecting its new parents. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any IDs are malformed or addParents/removeParents are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the file does not exist or any referenced parent folder does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to move the file or to add it into/remove it from the specified folders. Raises CONFLICT if the move would create an invalid state (for example, moving into a non-folder, removing the last required parent, or creating an ancestor/descendant cycle).

fileId.description: ID of the file (drive item) to move

addParents.description: Folder IDs to add as parents for the file

removeParents.description: Folder IDs to remove as parents for the file

tool_schemas.name: drive_file_empty_trash
tool_schemas.description: Permanently deletes all items currently in the authenticated user's trash and returns an empty success response. Items that are not trashed are not affected and the operation is not paged. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to permanently delete one or more trashed items, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request exceeds allowed rate or operation limits.

tool_schemas.name: drive_shared_drives_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists Shared Drives accessible to the authenticated user and returns a page of Shared Drive resources. Results are paged using pageSize and pageToken; the response includes nextPageToken when more results are available. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to list Shared Drives, and INVALID_ARGUMENT if pageSize is out of range or pageToken is malformed.

pageSize.description: Number of Shared Drives to return

tool_schemas.name: drive_shared_drive_get
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for the Shared Drive identified by driveId. The response contains the Shared Drive resource if it is accessible to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, NOT_FOUND if the driveId does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and INVALID_ARGUMENT if driveId is missing or malformed.

tool_schemas.name: drive_shared_drive_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new Shared Drive with the provided name (and optional colorRgb/hidden) and returns the created Shared Drive resource. The created drive is immediately available for subsequent reads and listings. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create Shared Drives, INVALID_ARGUMENT if name is empty or colorRgb is not a valid RGB value, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if creation limits are exceeded.

name.description: Name of the new Shared Drive

colorRgb.description: Color for the Shared Drive in RGB format

hidden.description: Whether the Shared Drive should be hidden

tool_schemas.name: drive_shared_drive_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the Shared Drive identified by driveId and returns an empty success response. Deletion is refused if the Shared Drive cannot be removed due to its current state or ownership/permission constraints. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, NOT_FOUND if the driveId does not exist or is not visible to the caller, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to delete the Shared Drive, and CONFLICT if the Shared Drive cannot be deleted in its current state.

driveId.description: ID of the Shared Drive to delete

tool_schemas.name: drive_shared_drive_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable metadata on the Shared Drive identified by driveId (name, colorRgb, hidden) and returns the updated Shared Drive resource. Only fields provided in the request are changed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, NOT_FOUND if the driveId does not exist or is not visible to the caller, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to update the Shared Drive, and INVALID_ARGUMENT if any provided field value (such as colorRgb) fails validation.

driveId.description: ID of the Shared Drive to update

name.description: New name for the Shared Drive

colorRgb.description: New color for the Shared Drive

hidden.description: Whether the Shared Drive should be hidden

tool_schemas.name: drive_shared_drive_files
tool_schemas.description: Lists files that belong to the Shared Drive identified by driveId and returns a page of file resources, optionally filtered by q and sorted by orderBy. Results are paged using pageSize and pageToken; the response includes nextPageToken when more results are available. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, NOT_FOUND if the driveId does not exist or is not visible to the caller, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list files in the Shared Drive, and INVALID_ARGUMENT if pageToken is malformed or orderBy/q is invalid.

tool_schemas.name: drive_storage_quota
tool_schemas.description: Get storage quota information for the user

tool_schemas.name: drive_storage_breakdown
tool_schemas.description: Returns a storage-usage breakdown aggregated by file type, limited to maxResults entries. The response contains the top file types by usage up to the requested limit. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view storage usage, and INVALID_ARGUMENT if maxResults is out of range.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of file types to return

tool_schemas.name: drive_batch_get_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for each fileId in fileIds as a single batch response, optionally limited to the comma-separated field set in fields. The response includes one result per requested file, and individual entries may indicate errors for file IDs that cannot be accessed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, INVALID_ARGUMENT if fileIds is empty or fields is malformed, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the batch size or request rate exceeds limits; per-item errors include NOT_FOUND for nonexistent or non-visible files and FORBIDDEN for insufficient access.

fileIds.description: Array of file IDs to retrieve metadata for

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include

tool_schemas.name: drive_batch_update_permissions
tool_schemas.description: Applies the listed permission update operations and returns a batch result describing success or failure per operation. Each operation updates the permissions on its target file according to permissionDetails (role/type plus emailAddress/domain when required). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if not signed in, INVALID_ARGUMENT if an operation is missing required fields or if emailAddress/domain is missing for the selected permission type, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the batch size or request rate exceeds limits, and per-operation errors including NOT_FOUND when a fileId does not exist or is not visible, FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot share or modify permissions, and CONFLICT when the requested permission change is not allowed in the file’s current sharing state.

fileId.description: ID of the file to update permissions for

tool_schemas.name: drive_batch_delete
tool_schemas.description: Deletes multiple items by ID; when permanent is false we move each item to Trash, and when true we permanently delete it, returning a per-item result indicating success or the error for that ID. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if fileIds is empty/invalid or contains duplicates, PERMISSION_DENIED if you lack delete/trash rights for an item, NOT_FOUND if any fileId does not exist or is not visible to you, and FAILED_PRECONDITION if an item is already permanently deleted or otherwise cannot transition to the requested deleted state.

fileIds.description: Array of file IDs to delete

permanent.description: Whether to delete permanently (true) or move to trash (false)

tool_schemas.name: drive_batch_copy
tool_schemas.description: Copies multiple source files, optionally renaming each copy and optionally placing it into a destination folder, returning the created file metadata (including new IDs) per operation. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if operations is empty/invalid or newName is invalid, NOT_FOUND if a source fileId or destinationFolderId does not exist or is not visible to you, PERMISSION_DENIED if you cannot read the source or write into the destination, and FAILED_PRECONDITION if the destinationFolderId is not a folder or the source item cannot be copied (for example due to its current state).

fileId.description: ID of the file to copy

operations.description: Array of copy operations to perform

tool_schemas.implementation:
def drive_batch_copy(operations, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0029000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0029000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, error_code=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": f"rl_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}_{len(logs)+1}",
            "endpoint": "drive_batch_copy",
            "credential_id": None,
            "status": status,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "timestamp": now
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(operations, list) or len(operations) == 0:
        _log("error", "VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "operations must be a non-empty array")

    items = _load("drive_items.json")
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        items = []
    parents = _load("drive_item_parents.json")
    if not isinstance(parents, list):
        parents = []
    versions = _load("file_versions.json")
    if not isinstance(versions, list):
        versions = []

    items_by_id = {it.get("id"): it for it in items if isinstance(it, dict) and isinstance(it.get("id"), str)}

    def _copy_one(src_id, dst_folder_id, nm):
        src = items_by_id.get(src_id)
        if not src or src.get("status") == "deleted":
            return None, _err("NOT_FOUND", "Source file not found")["error"]
        if src.get("locked") is True:
            return None, _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "PERMISSION_DENIED: source item is locked")["error"]

        dst = None
        if dst_folder_id is not None:
            dst = items_by_id.get(dst_folder_id)
            if not dst or dst.get("status") == "deleted" or dst.get("item_type") != "folder":
                return None, _err("NOT_FOUND", "Destination folder not found")["error"]
            if src.get("shared_drive_id") != dst.get("shared_drive_id"):
                return None, _err("CONFLICT", "Source and destination must be in the same drive scope (shared_drive_id)")["error"]

        # determine destination: if missing, keep same parents (copy first active parent if any)
        dest_folder = dst_folder_id
        if dest_folder is None:
            src_pars = [p for p in parents if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("item_id") == src_id]
            if src_pars:
                dest_folder = src_pars[0].get("parent_folder_id")
        if dest_folder is None:
            # if no parent, allow rootless copy (still create item)
            dest_folder = None

        new_id = "gdrv_itm_" + secrets.token_hex(12)
        name = (nm.strip() if isinstance(nm, str) and nm.strip() else (src.get("name") or "Copy"))
        owner = src.get("owner_principal") or "principal_unknown"
        new_item = {
            "id": new_id,
            "shared_drive_id": src.get("shared_drive_id"),
            "owner_principal": owner,
            "name": name,
            "mime_type": src.get("mime_type"),
            "item_type": src.get("item_type"),
            "shortcut_target_item_id": src.get("shortcut_target_item_id"),
            "description": src.get("description"),
            "starred": bool(src.get("starred")),
            "locked": False,
            "trashed_at": None,
            "status": "active",
            "size_bytes": int(src.get("size_bytes") or 0),
            "content_blob_id": src.get("content_blob_id"),
            "content_text_encoding": src.get("content_text_encoding"),
            "md5_checksum": src.get("md5_checksum"),
            "modified_by_principal": src.get("modified_by_principal") or owner,
            "modified_at": now,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now
        }
        if new_item["item_type"] == "folder":
            new_item["size_bytes"] = 0
            new_item["content_blob_id"] = None
            new_item["md5_checksum"] = None

        # version for files
        new_ver = None
        if new_item["item_type"] == "file":
            max_seq = 0
            for v in versions:
                if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(v.get("change_sequence"), int) and v["change_sequence"] > max_seq:
                    max_seq = v["change_sequence"]
            new_seq = max_seq + 1 if max_seq > 0 else 1
            ver_id = "gdrv_ver_" + secrets.token_hex(12)
            # If original has no blob, keep empty
            if not src.get("content_blob_id"):
                new_item["content_blob_id"] = None
                new_item["size_bytes"] = 0
                new_item["md5_checksum"] = None
            versions.append({
                "id": ver_id,
                "item_id": new_id,
                "version_number": 1,
                "blob_id": new_item.get("content_blob_id") or ("gdrv_blob_" + secrets.token_hex(16)),
                "mime_type": new_item.get("mime_type") or "application/octet-stream",
                "size_bytes": int(new_item.get("size_bytes") or 0),
                "md5_checksum": new_item.get("md5_checksum"),
                "created_by_principal": new_item.get("modified_by_principal") or owner,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
                "status": "active",
                "change_sequence": new_seq
            })
            new_ver = {"id": ver_id, "versionNumber": 1, "changeSequence": new_seq}

        items.append(new_item)
        items_by_id[new_id] = new_item

        if dest_folder is not None:
            parents.append({
                "id": "gdrv_par_" + secrets.token_hex(12),
                "item_id": new_id,
                "parent_folder_id": dest_folder,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now
            })

        return {"item": new_item, "newVersion": new_ver}, None

    results = []
    any_changed = False

    for idx, op in enumerate(operations):
        if not isinstance(op, dict):
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": False, "error": _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "operation must be an object")["error"]})
            continue
        fid = op.get("fileId")
        dst = op.get("destinationFolderId")
        nm = op.get("newName")
        if not isinstance(fid, str) or not fid.strip():
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": False, "error": _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "fileId is required")["error"]})
            continue
        if dst is not None and (not isinstance(dst, str) or not dst.strip()):
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": False, "error": _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "destinationFolderId must be a string when provided")["error"]})
            continue
        if nm is not None and (not isinstance(nm, str) or not nm.strip()):
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": False, "error": _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "newName must be a non-empty string when provided")["error"]})
            continue

        out, err = _copy_one(fid.strip(), dst.strip() if isinstance(dst, str) else None, nm)
        if err:
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": False, "error": err})
        else:
            any_changed = True
            results.append({"index": idx, "ok": True, **out})

    if any_changed:
        _save("drive_items.json", items)
        _save("drive_item_parents.json", parents)
        _save("file_versions.json", versions)

    _log("success", None)
    return {"results": results}

tool_schemas.name: drive_batch_move
tool_schemas.description: Moves multiple files into a destination folder and, when removeFromCurrentFolders is true, removes the item from its existing parent folders; returns per-operation updated file metadata. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT if operations is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if a fileId or destinationFolderId does not exist or is not visible to you, PERMISSION_DENIED if you lack permission to move the item or write into the destination, and FAILED_PRECONDITION if destinationFolderId is not a folder or the requested move is not allowed (for example moving a folder into itself/its descendant or leaving an item without any parent when removals are requested).

fileId.description: ID of the file to move

removeFromCurrentFolders.description: Whether to remove from current folders (true) or keep in current folders (false)

operations.description: Array of move operations to perform

tool_schemas.name: drive_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates writable metadata for an existing Drive item (file, folder, or shortcut) and returns the updated item metadata. Supports renaming, updating description, toggling starred/locked, and moving the item between lifecycle states (trash/restore/delete) via the status field. Raises NOT_FOUND if fileId does not exist or is not visible to you, FAILED_PRECONDITION for invalid state transitions or attempts to mutate locked items without sufficient role, and PERMISSION_DENIED if you lack write access.

fileId.description: ID of the Drive item to update

name.description: New name for the item; must be non-empty when provided

status.description: New lifecycle status for the item. Use trashed to move to trash, active to restore, and deleted for permanent deletion (cannot be undone).

tool_schemas.name: drive_permissions_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or upserts) a permission granting access to a file or folder and returns the resulting permission resource. Use this to share with a user, domain, or anyone. Raises NOT_FOUND if fileId does not exist or is not visible to you, INVALID_ARGUMENT for invalid combinations (for example emailAddress provided for type=anyone/domain), and PERMISSION_DENIED if you are not allowed to manage sharing for the item.

fileId.description: ID of the item to share

emailAddress.description: Email address for type=user or type=group

allowDiscovery.description: Whether the item is discoverable in search for type=domain or type=anyone

tool_schemas.name: drive_comment_create
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new top-level comment on the specified file and returns the created comment. Raises NOT_FOUND if fileId does not exist or is not visible to you, FAILED_PRECONDITION if comments are not allowed for the item type or state, and PERMISSION_DENIED if you lack permission to comment.

fileId.description: ID of the file to comment on
